content.query:
with ECIF AS(
    SELECT 'Entity_CIF_1' AS Entity_CIF, 'CRM' AS SOURCE, 'MANILA' AS ADDRESS UNION ALL --EXPTECTED MANILA
    SELECT 'Entity_CIF_1' AS Entity_CIF, 'CCD' AS SOURCE, 'MAKATI' AS ADDRESS UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Entity_CIF_1' AS Entity_CIF, 'SEC' AS SOURCE, 'MANDA'  AS ADDRESS UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Entity_CIF_2' AS Entity_CIF, 'CCD' AS SOURCE, 'PASAY' AS ADDRESS UNION ALL --EXPTECTED PASAY
    SELECT 'Entity_CIF_2' AS Entity_CIF, 'SEC' AS SOURCE, 'PASIG' AS ADDRESS UNION ALL 
    SELECT 'Entity_CIF_3' AS Entity_CIF, 'SEC' AS SOURCE, 'PARANQ' AS ADDRESS UNION ALL --EXPTECTED PARANQ
    SELECT 'Entity_CIF_4' AS Entity_CIF, 'CRM' AS SOURCE, 'SAN JUAN' AS ADDRESS UNION ALL  --EXPTECTED SAN JUAN
    SELECT 'Entity_CIF_4' AS Entity_CIF, 'SEC' AS SOURCE, 'ESPANIA' AS ADDRESS UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Entity_CIF_5' AS Entity_CIF, 'CRM' AS SOURCE, 'QUIRINO' AS ADDRESS UNION ALL  --EXPTECTED QUIRINO
    SELECT 'Entity_CIF_5' AS Entity_CIF, 'CCD' AS SOURCE, 'QUIAPO' AS ADDRESS UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Entity_CIF_6' AS Entity_CIF, 'CRM' AS SOURCE, 'TONDO' AS ADDRESS UNION ALL  --EXPTECTED ANY
    SELECT 'Entity_CIF_6' AS Entity_CIF, 'CRM' AS SOURCE, 'QUEZON' AS ADDRESS 
 
),
HIERARCCHY AS (
    SELECT 1 AS SEQ, 'CRM' SOURCE UNION ALL
    SELECT 2 AS SEQ, 'CCD' SOURCE UNION ALL
    SELECT 3 AS SEQ, 'SEC' SOURCE
)

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY Entity_CIF ORDER BY SEQ) RN, Entity_CIF,A.SOURCE,ADDRESS FROM ECIF A
LEFT JOIN HIERARCCHY B ON A.SOURCE = B.SOURCE
) A WHERE RN = 1
